source_logloss_note: BCE uses source-dtype epsilon clipping then float64 logs; original sklearn logloss equality is not required.
bce_denominator: Actual resampled row count, not number of resampled users.
uncertainty: Exploratory 95% percentile intervals conditional on fixed checkpoints; no training-seed, multiplicity or selection correction.
interpretation: All twenty-nine predeclared comparisons retained, including negative effects; no conditional pairs. Task differences use paired effect differences. A significant task and an inconclusive task do not establish task heterogeneity. No winner or incumbent decision.
availability_scope: Common rows and strict masks do not establish actual online behavior/ingestion times.
source_and_input_identity_scope: Inherited original input content hashes plus frozen run stat continuity and original row-stream fingerprints; actual arrays revalidated in statistical execution.
